notes: Slice 2 of 3 of the scene list: catalog.groups() with room scene, items[N*1//3 : N*2//3], 206 pictures. 192 kept, 14 dropped, 0 cropped.
Dropped (14): 5 same shot or re-taken frames, 6 lyric or credit text frames of the Layla and Fanny weapon film, 1 frame with a burned in subtitle, 1 blurred frame, 1 near black frame.
Rule for text in a frame: scenery text (screens, signs, scoreboards, labels drawn in the chibi short) stays. Text laid over the picture (lyrics, credits, subtitles) is dropped. No picture is cropped.
The bars field of the inventory is wrong for the dark 2.37 to 1 frames (slice positions 26, 146, 150, 157, 163, 172, 173, 176): it is vignette, not letterbox. Never crop from bars.

The dhash match of near_groups is unreliable on dark 2.37 to 1 frames. Matches among slice positions 146, 147, 150, 175 and items of slices 1 and 3, also with the pixel size check off, were all looked at and are different pictures.
Four frames (slice positions 8 to 11) are portrait 810x1440 and come from a vertical video, as did the dropped position 12.

items.title: Fliers circle above Ruby
items.alt: Ruby stands with her back to the viewer, a long scythe in hand, as armored androids hover over a burning street.

items.title: Ruby's red eyes in the blast
items.alt: Ruby leans across a long staff with red glowing eyes, bright explosions all around her.

items.title: Ruby leaps with lightning
items.alt: Ruby swings a long weapon that crackles with yellow lightning, her black hair streaming.

items.title: Ruby and two figures in flames
items.alt: Ruby stands among flames in the center of a ruined street, a boy in a school blazer on the right and a small red haired figure on the left.

items.title: Ruby and a seated student
items.alt: Ruby points a long weapon across a rocky slope where a Selrick student sits against a stone, a small plush on the ground.

items.title: Ruby's weapon beside a student
items.alt: Seen from the side, Ruby's legs and weapon stand beside a Selrick student sitting on the ground.

items.title: Oro soldiers in the hangar
items.alt: Armored Oro soldiers stand in a bright hangar, a small pink haired girl between two of them.

items.title: Angela loads on the lab screen
items.alt: A holographic panel shows the name Angela and a loading bar on a lab console.

items.title: A hand on the lab console
items.alt: A metal gloved hand presses a glowing cyan ring on a lab console with data panels.

items.title: Ruby holds a pink plush
items.alt: Ruby stands in a dark hall with tall pillars and holds a pink plush toy close to her chest.

items.title: Ruby in the Council hall
items.alt: Ruby stands with her hands folded in front of the dark pillars of the Council hall.

items.title: Ruby beside a man in fur
items.alt: Ruby looks aside in profile while a man in a fur collar stands close, his face out of frame.

items.title: A guard in the Council hall
items.alt: A guard in white and gold armor stands in a tall hall with pale blue lamps and arches.
